footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes a $672K income tax benefit.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 0.3% to $150M in 2025. Gross margin was 75.9%, versus 91.8% a year earlier, and the operating loss narrowed to $72.8M from $111M.
The net loss widened to $74.6M, or −$1.18 per share, from $67.0M. Operating cash flow was −$81.0M and free cash flow −$83.0M, versus −$72.1M.
sources: MacroGenics, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

We depend substantially on the development potential of our product candidates, through our own efforts or those of our collaborators
Drug development involves a lengthy and expensive process, with a highly uncertain outcome
Our product candidates may have undesirable side effects which may delay or prevent further clinical development or marketing approval, or…
